scenes.basis: 18:1 "Paul departed from Athens, and came to Corinth"; 18:4 "He reasoned in the synagogue every Sabbath, and persuaded Jews and Greeks"
18:18 "He shaved his head in Cenchreae, for he had a vow" - the sail-off from Corinth for Syria is the departure leg

18:19 "He came to Ephesus, and he left them there; but he himself entered into the synagogue, and reasoned with the Jews"; 18:21 "Then he set sail from Ephesus" - Jerusalem in 18:21 is a plan, never a setting
18:22 "When he had landed at Caesarea, he went up and greeted the assembly, and went down to Antioch" - the landing is at Caesarea; the greeting and the descent are the onward legs

18:23 "Having spent some time there, he departed, and went through the region of Galatia, and Phrygia, in order, establishing all the disciples" - the stay follows 18:22 "went down to Antioch"; the journey through Galatia and Phrygia is the departure leg
18:24 "a certain Jew named Apollos, an Alexandrian by race, an eloquent man, came to Ephesus"; 18:26 "He began to speak boldly in the synagogue"
